messages:
anna: quick update — rolled microkernel-prefetch-orchestrator to a 5% canary on g5x this morning. initial numbers look solid: p50 down ~40% for sub-8-token flows, overall cost/token -15%.

dave: wow that's huge. is that primarily from better kernel packing or the prefetch ordering?

anna: both. orchestrator batches tiny requests into a single microkernel launch and prioritizes prefetches based on downstream likelihood score. also tightened the launch hot-path so kernel startup is ~10ms faster.

perf-bot: canary-deploy 1999999999: applied to pool g5x-canary-2 — 5% traffic. health checks: OK. p50: -40%. p95: +1%. p99: +3% (within SLO). cost/token: -15%.

marta: any regression on quality or retries? microbatching can change ordering semantics.

anna: ran full smoke suite. generation-regression: 0.0% (noise), rerank-stability: unchanged, client-retries: +0.01% (within baseline). we added a deterministic ordering guard so older clients see consistent token ordering.

dave: curious about memory/GPU occupancy impact? we previously saw microbatching increase peak mem.

anna: memory up ~6% on canary but we reduced workspace padding and enabled dynamic-slab reclaim — net GPU headroom improved due to fewer kernel launches. also added a model whitelist for orchestrator; legacy models stay on the old path.

perf-bot: smoke-evals link: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/rollout/1999999999 — includes BLEU-like proxy, hallucination probes, and retries.

marta: rollout safety? thresholds to auto-rollback?

anna: yes. automated rollback if p99 > +10% for 10m OR generation-regression > 1.0% on the smoke set. also rollback on error-rate spike > 0.5%. we've added a soft-disable flag per node to drop to baseline without a full rollout abort.

dave: when do we plan a broader ramp?

anna: plan is 25% in 48h if canary stable for 12h, then 70% over next 24h. will post a short blurb for eng-all-hands and ping product.

marta: please add graphs for p50/p95/p99 and cost/token delta in the release note. happy to help with the wording.

anna: will do. thanks everyone :rocket:
